<style>
/* ─── Google Fonts ─── */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&family=DM+Mono:wght@400&display=swap');

/* ─── Root tokens (journal-compatible) ─── */
:root {
  --accent:    #c0392b;
  --accent2:   #e74c3c;
  --ink:       #1a1a2e;
  --muted:     #6b7280;
  --surface:   #f9f6f1;
  --card-bg:   #ffffff;
  --border:    #e5e0d8;
  --tag-bg:    #fef3f2;
  --tag-color: #9b2335;
  --radius:    10px;
  --shadow:    0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.07);
}

/* ─── Typography override (keep journal nav/header intact) ─── */
.hero-name, .section-title, .card-title {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
}
.hero-tagline, .hero-bio, .card-desc, .skill-chip, .stat-label {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   HERO BAND
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.hero-band {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 55%, #0f3460 100%);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 4rem 3rem 3.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3rem;
}

/* Decorative corner motif */
.hero-band::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -60px; right: -60px;
  width: 280px; height: 280px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(192,57,43,.35) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-band::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: -80px; left: 30%;
  width: 200px; height: 200px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(231,76,60,.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* Avatar circle */
.hero-avatar {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 120px; height: 120px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #922b21);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 2.8rem;
  color: #fff;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(192,57,43,.4), 0 0 0 8px rgba(192,57,43,.15);
}

.hero-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

.hero-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .72rem;
  letter-spacing: .18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--accent2);
  background: rgba(231,76,60,.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(231,76,60,.35);
  border-radius: 4px;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.hero-name {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.9rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  line-height: 1.15;
  margin: 0 0 .6rem;
}

.hero-tagline {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);
  font-weight: 300;
  margin: 0 0 1.6rem;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
}

.hero-links {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .6rem;
}

.hero-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all .2s ease;
}
.hero-link.primary {
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);
}
.hero-link.primary:hover {
  background: #a93226;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(192,57,43,.45);
}
.hero-link.ghost {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}
.hero-link.ghost:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   STATS ROW
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.stats-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
.stat-card {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 1.4rem 1.2rem;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  transition: transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.stat-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
}
.stat-number {
  font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--accent);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: .35rem;
}
.stat-label {
  font-size: .78rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  font-weight: 500;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   SKILLS SECTION
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.section-title {
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin: 0 0 1.2rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .6rem;
}
.section-title::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--accent), transparent);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.skills-panel {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 1.8rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}

.skills-grid {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
}
.skill-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; }
.skill-name {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .82rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--ink);
  min-width: 130px;
}
.skill-bar-bg {
  flex: 1;
  height: 7px;
  background: #f0ece6;
  border-radius: 99px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.skill-bar {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent2));
  animation: growBar .8s ease forwards;
  transform-origin: left;
}
@keyframes growBar {
  from { transform: scaleX(0); }
  to   { transform: scaleX(1); }
}
.skill-pct {
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .72rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  min-width: 34px;
  text-align: right;
}

.chip-cloud { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem; margin-top: 1.2rem; }
.skill-chip {
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  background: var(--tag-bg);
  color: var(--tag-color);
  border: 1px solid #f5c6c3;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.two-col {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}
@media (max-width: 700px) {
  .two-col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .hero-band { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
  .hero-links { justify-content: center; }
  .stats-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   EXERCISE CARDS
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.card-panel {
  background: var(--card-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 1.8rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.exercise-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.exercise-list li {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: .7rem 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .7rem;
}
.exercise-list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.ex-badge {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 30px; height: 30px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--tag-bg);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
  font-size: .65rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.ex-link {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .85rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.3;
  transition: color .15s;
}
.ex-link:hover { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: underline; }
.ex-chapter {
  margin-left: auto;
  font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;

}

.takehome-cards { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
.takehome-card {

}

}
.card-links { display: flex; gap: .6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.card-btn {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: .78rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 5px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all .15s;
}
.card-btn.filled {
  background: var(--accent);

}
.card-btn.filled:hover { background: #a93226; }
.card-btn.outline {
  border: 1px solid var(--accent);

}
.card-btn.outline:hover { background: var(--tag-bg); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
